summary: fsgg.managed-group-contract/1 (eng/managed_group_owner.py, single stdlib file pinned by commit/path/sha256) is the supplier contract the Templates WASM caller binds at its Chromium support/runtime join (FS-GG/.github#4710 C-J1; Coordination #1046 under #1026). It is a sibling of eng/shared_process_owner.py, which contains by numeric process group and refuses detached groups/sessions; stock Playwright browser and Vite servers create such groups, and BCL Process sessions cannot observe re-parented descendants. Containment is a fresh leaf under an exclusive delegated cgroup v2 root; setsid/double-fork stays contained, a process moving elsewhere in the root is an escape (refused and pidfd-killed); the leader gets no_new_privs. Birth is the unreaped child's pidfd plus start ticks and a /proc/<pid>/exe digest checked against profile leaderImages; the executable is hashed from an O_NOFOLLOW descriptor and exec'd through it. Retirement is pidfd SIGTERM, grace, kernel cgroup.kill, populated 0, leaf removal; removal failure is reported (observed-empty-remove-failed), never hidden. Closed refusal codes precede launch, including containment-unavailable with the probe reason. Environment finding: GitHub-hosted Ubuntu supplies delegation through sudo systemd-run with Delegate=yes, User=runner, NoNewPrivileges=yes, KillMode=control-group and a short TimeoutStopSec (default 90s stop delays SIGTERM-ignoring members); the local dev container (catatonit PID1, root-owned cgroupns root, no sudo) cannot delegate and the owner refuses there. Supervisor-death cleanup is the unit's job, not the owner's. A unit with NoNewPrivileges=yes masks the owner's own prctl, so the no_new_privs control must run without it (found by the mutation proof). Hosted compiler-and-tests on the PR ran 8 refusal + 14 containment controls, an owner-death control and 19/19 single-fragment mutants killed. Not established: hosted Templates runtime, browser support closure, the 27-case journey, publication or installed acceptance; an earlier managed-group checkpoint 5f7094bf was not found in any repository.
title: Managed-group candidate contract contains browser/process groups by delegated cgroup v2 with pidfd birth
